description: Implement lazy communication media Records, source-node hydration, AI-only modality projection, access-driven trace artifacts, and authorized BO retrieval from the final PRD.

comments.text:
Accepted implementation-plan amendment (2026-10-29): request-scoped, revisable outgoing attachment selection.
Source design: https://chatgpt.com/space/page_bdc818e595dc8191ac1712b564afda86 and user agreement in this session.

Contract: attach_documents accepts operation add/remove/replace and a list of Records; add deduplicates, remove of an absent selection is an idempotent no-op, replace([]) clears. Validate the whole operation before any mutation. Return validated Records for the invocation and an accepted selection effect; success means selected, not delivered. Removal never deletes the source document. GetDocument stays unchanged.

The runtime supplies the actual Jido Request.Handle.id through trusted context; no model-supplied request ID or authority. One authoritative selection belongs to one active execution/runtime incarnation across its inference/tool iterations. Jido execution state owns selection; StreamEvents carries accepted changes/final snapshot, without a second independent selection catalog. Request ID scopes state, but invocation identity and deterministic ordering/revision are also required for replay safety and conflicting concurrent operations. A replayed add must not undo a later remove. Reject stale/cross-request effects; start new requests empty; discard pending selection on failure/cancellation; freeze at successful completion. Steering an active request may cause subsequent selection changes; a new request cannot retract delivered files.

Delivery: StreamEvents -> Executor success result -> Pipeline result rebuild -> existing Outgoing.attachments -> Channels materialization and authorization. Keep Records/effects out of persisted tool traces and public tool steps. Do not send selected files during intermediate streaming.

Scope evidence: lib/zaq/agent/stream_events.ex initializes request_id from the actual request handle; executor.ex passes request and rebuilds success results; pipeline.ex result_from_answering/3 currently omits attachments; tools/registry.ex explicitly registers tools; engine/messages/outgoing.ex already accepts result.attachments. Expect at least five production-file boundaries: new AttachDocuments Action, tools/registry.ex, stream_events.ex, executor.ex, pipeline.ex. Factory/context/effect/alias wiring may require additional files after discovery. Three production files is not a confirmed complete scope.

Tests to add before implementation: add/remove/replace/clear; full-batch rejection without partial state; dedup and collection bounds; trusted Record/alias provenance and nil/unauthorized actor rejection; same-request multi-iteration changes; cross-request/runtime isolation; replay after removal; concurrent conflicting operation ordering; cancellation/failure/late completion; real tool registration/selection; no Record/effect leakage into traces/history/public steps; final attachments preserved through both configured-agent and default Pipeline paths. Property tests for operation sequences, isolation, and replay invariants. Preserve existing test behavior. Mock only external edges; exercise internal boundaries. Human feature E2E approval is required before new E2E authoring if E2E is needed.

Action reuse assessment: this update changes planning only (no executable operation change). Intended implementation proposes one generic selection Action, reuses existing Record/alias authorization, extends request-state and result propagation, and reuses Outgoing/Channels delivery. GetDocument retrieves rather than selects; it should not acquire selection side effects. Full Action/provenance/state-effect discovery remains a prerequisite before implementation; verify pinned Jido trusted context and effect transport and create ordered implementation child issues with complete reuse assessments. Do not treat this amendment as proof the dependency supports the whole path.

Documentation/validation: update Agent service contracts with implementation, keep the Page design clearly unimplemented until validated, follow docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md validation lifecycle and post-review coverage handoff. This amendment authorizes planning only; no production/test code changed.
